meta.title: The invited vendor opens a live RFQ
gaps: Verify that Delivery location is read-only in the vendor sheet.
Verify that the Price column is editable in the vendor sheet.
Verify the live countdown value or countdown behavior.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that Delivery location is read-only in the vendor sheet.; Verify that the Price column is editable in the vendor sheet.; Verify the live countdown value or countdown behavior.

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ summary; this is the required starting point for prepared-state cases.
Move to the supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ from Vendor A's event list and enter its pricing sheet.
Verify the vendor sees the RFQ title from the prepared event.
Verify the product quantity shown to the vendor matches the event data.
Verify the product unit shown to the vendor matches the event data.
Verify the Terms & Conditions section is present.
Verify the quotation template section is present.
Verify a template download control is available.
Verify the product sheet includes the delivery-location field.
Verify the product sheet includes the Price column.
Verify the vendor has the control needed to submit a bid.
